Book.title: The Jukebox Masterclass
Book.author: Lizzie
Book.Page:
Welcome to the Jukebox Mod!
Power the Jukebox with [FF0000]10 Watts[-], then use it to browse the tracks unlocked in that machine.

The Jukebox Masterclass is a craftable field guide. Make it at a workbench with 1 Flux Cell and 10 Paper, then use the book from your inventory or toolbelt to open this manual.
The Flux Cell is supplied by the core LizziesMod crafting chain. The book is reusable, so one copy can remain with your music equipment as a reference.
Find a Walkman and keep it in your inventory. Use a cassette from your inventory to play it through the Walkman. Cassettes are reusable.
Aim a music disc at a powered Jukebox and use it to install the track. The disc is consumed, and the track remains unlocked for that Jukebox after saving and loading.
The first player to install a disc becomes the Jukebox owner. Owners can set a Duke price for visitors from the Jukebox Library, while their own playback is always free.

Book.title: Jukebox And Walkman: Technical Reference
Book.author: llydia
Book.Page:
LizziesMod_JukeboxAndWalkman adds a powered Jukebox, portable Walkmans, reusable cassettes, and installable music discs. The menu library readme documents the technical behavior; the Jukebox Masterclass is the separate craftable in-world manual.
Audio definitions are declared in Config/CustomAudio.xml. Item and block definitions live in Config/items.xml and Config/blocks.xml.

blockJukebox is a powered block and requires 10 watts. Install a music disc by aiming it at a powered Jukebox and using it. The disc is consumed and its track is unlocked for that specific machine.
The first player to install a disc becomes the Jukebox owner. Owners can set a Duke price for visitors through the Jukebox Library; owner playback remains free. Unlocked tracks persist with the Jukebox across save and load.

Keep an itemWalkman in the inventory, then use a cassette item from the inventory to play it through the Walkman. Cassettes are reusable.
The included cassette and test disc both reference the track identifier LizziesMod_JukeboxAndWalkman:explanation-of-an-entity. Media items declare their kind with MediaType (cassette or disc) and their playback source with TrackName.

VolumeLevel controls the mod's audio volume. MinJukeboxDistance and MaxJukeboxDistance define the distance range used for Jukebox audio behavior. These settings are available under LizziesMod_JukeboxAndWalkman in Mod Settings.
When adding tracks, ensure the CustomAudio definition, TrackName value, and audio asset identifier agree exactly. A missing or mismatched track name is reported in the client log and will not play.
